                            ;*  b4–b5: Timer X operating mode                                                               *

                            ;*      11 = Pulse width measurement mode                                                       *

                            ;*      - Pulse output mode: 0 = start at "H", 1 = start at "L"                                 *
                            ;*      - Event counter: 0 = rising edge, 1 = falling edge                                      *
                            ;*      - Pulse width measurement: 0 = measure "H" width, 1 = measure "L" width                 *

                            ;************************************************************************************************
                            ;*  A-D Control Register (ADCON) [Address 0x34]                                                 *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b0–b2: Analog input pin selection bits                                                      *
                            ;*      000 = AN0, 001 = AN1, ..., 111 = AN7                                                    *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b3: A-D conversion completion bit                                                           *
                            ;*      0 = Conversion in progress                                                              *
                            ;*      1 = Conversion completed                                                                *
                            ;*      Note: Must be cleared to "0" to start conversion                                        *
                            ;*            (when using internal trigger)                                                     *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b4: VREF input switch                                                                       *
                            ;*      0 = VREF OFF                                                                            *
                            ;*      1 = VREF ON                                                                             *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b5: A-D external trigger valid bit                                                          *
                            ;*      0 = Internal trigger (bit 3 used to start conversion)                                   *
                            ;*      1 = External trigger enabled                                                            *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b6: Interrupt source selection                                                              *
                            ;*      0 = Interrupt on conversion complete                                                    *
                            ;*      1 = Interrupt on falling edge of ADT pin                                                *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b7: Reserved (fixed to 0, cannot be written)                                                *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  Note:                                                                                       *
                            ;*  When an internal trigger is selected, A-D conversion                                        *
                            ;*  is started by setting bit 3 to “0.” Writing only “0”                                        *
                            ;*  to bit 3 is valid. Even if “1” is written to bit 3,                                         *
                            ;*  it is not set to “0.” Accordingly, to write values to                                       *
                            ;*  the ADCON without affecting bit 3,                                                          *
                            ;*  set bit 3 to “1.”                                                                           *
                            ;************************************************************************************************

                            ;*                                                                                              *

                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b4: Port Xc switch bit                                                                      *

                            ;*      1 = XcIN, XcOUT (external clock I/O)                                                    *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b5: Main clock (XIN–XOUT) stop bit                                                          *
                            ;*      0 = Oscillating                                                                         *
                            ;*      1 = Stopped                                                                             *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b6: Main clock division ratio selection                                                     *
                            ;*      0 = f(XIN)/2 (high-speed mode)                                                          *
                            ;*      1 = f(XIN)/8 (middle-speed mode)                                                        *
                            ;*                                                                                              *
                            ;*  b7: Internal system clock source selection                                                  *
